prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: deep magenta. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: a large paper coin; a paper document.
Opens on the map shape, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off as the map shape curls into one large paper coin; a document lands beside it and holds.
Ends holding on the large coin.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "$1.5B BET".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "$1.5B BET". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "The one point five billion Resulticks deal is the transformative bet.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a cinematic, 2D motion design piece in a modern editorial paper collage style, photographed as a flat lay under soft, natural room light coming from the upper left. <Picture 1> serves as the opening frame, featuring a light blue paper ground, a cream paper chip with the text "$77B BRAZIL", and a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a map with rough white torn edges. Immediately upon the start of the video, the light blue ground is instantaneously covered by a single, unbroken block of deep magenta paper. The existing cream chip and the map cutout slide quickly off-frame to the left with a slight overshoot. Simultaneously, a new cream paper chip lands firmly in the upper third of the frame, featuring the stable, extra-bold black sans-serif text "$1.5B BET" in clean, legible lettering with safe margins. In the lower two-thirds of the frame, the map shape rapidly curls and morphs into a large, black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a coin, which has rough white torn edges and no markings or symbols on its surface. A second black-and-white halftone cutout of a blank document, also with rough white torn edges, flies in from the right and lands crisply beside the coin. Both the coin and the document cast small, soft shadows toward the bottom right, consistent with the upper-left lighting. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout. As the sequence concludes, the composition holds steady, with the coin and document resting on the deep magenta ground under a matte finish. A narrator (S1), a man with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk, professional speaking rate, says <d>[English] The one point five billion Resulticks deal is the transformative bet.</d> starting from the first frame.

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the voice of the narrator. Beneath the speech, there are tactile, diegetic sound effects consisting of a crisp paper slap as the chip and document land, and a subtle, sticky sound of adhesive tape being pressed down.
